Fill their gap at x60..71,y12..13. Add no paint outside that gap. Coordinates increase right and down; all ranges are inclusive.

The new bridge must cover every cell x60 through71 on those two rows, with no new cells elsewhere. Use one offered tool or stop. Coordinates increase right and down; bounds are inclusive.
cases.subgoal: Existing material58: left rectangle [52,12,8,2], right rectangle [72,12,8,2]. The gap is 12 columns wide and two rows high. Rectangle notation is [x,y,width,height]. Select one complete tool/profile; a short or displaced patch can be legal without connecting both pads.

cases.objective: Join the separated vertical paint58 bars at x18..19. The upper bar covers y52..59 and the lower bar y72..79. cases.objective: Build a continuous two-cell-wide support at x66..67 between the roof ending at y53 and the base beginning at y70. The roof is x52..75,y52..53 and the base x52..75,y70..71. cases.subgoal: Existing strip [12,82,8,2]. The empty target [20,82,16,2] starts immediately to its right and contains 32 cells. Rectangle notation is [x,y,width,height]. Choose one finite extension profile; all offered profiles are legal to execute.
